verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents ZeroTrace Mode, which stops it from storing search parameters, files, or data, so users get a first-party way to opt out of retention. Other docs show that by default searches are cached for 1h and kept retrievable through the Searches Archive API. There is no documented way to delete data that is already stored or to set a custom retention window. Missing for 10: deletion of already-stored searches or archive data, configurable retention periods, detailed ZeroTrace documentation (which plans include it, how to enable it), independent corroboration.
